comment: Dr. Dagger is an absolute stud. The man looks and talks like what you expect from a great professor. You do have a lot of reading, but it is manageable. There are also a lot of papers, but it truly helped me grow my writing ability so much. He gives you thoughtful critiques on your work that you actually learn from it. Take him if you want to grow!

Doctor Dagger was a great professor for his FYS. There was a lot of writing and class could be a bit tedious at times, but he clearly cares about the content and if you put in the work, you can do well.

Dr. Dagger's class is difficult, but if you are genuinely seeking to enhance your writing abilities and knowledge of the foundations of modern political systems, this is a great class to take. He is articulate and thorough in his lectures, and wants everyone to be on the same page before he moves on to the next topic. Dude is a stud.

Don't get me wrong he is a good teacher and really knows what he is talking about, but he just expects way too much out of your writing and often critics every word. He is not a professor you take for a walk in the park.

Dr. Dagger is a caring professor with a crazy good memory! The readings for his FYS were extremely interesting, and he provided adequate background information to the readings but also allowed the students to guide the discussion. We were prompted to ask questions, clarify our answers, and investigate the validity of the texts.
Great senior seminar -- learned a lot and Dagger is an incredible professor.

He's a nice guy, but he knows he's smart and he doesn't give anyone good grades. Smartest kids in the class get B+'s, and he takes off points on his tests for no reason. Same teaching style the whole year. Nice guy, very average teacher.
Really good teacher and a really enjoyable classes but he was a really hard grader. I only know of two or three people in the class of 24 who got an -A or higher

Cool guy, and a good writer. I wouldn't call him pretentious.... but he knows he's smart. Structures the course load in a way where you get the most out of the material. Tests are very straightforward, if you've done the homework and taken notes you'll be fine. Don't try to use the bathroom during class.

Dagger is like everyones grandpa, or rather zany uncle. He is a genius with the material and continually tries to spice things up with modern day references and often some Harry Potter references. I have learned an immense amount in this class, and while it wasn't too easy, I would take it again!

Really good prof, he's the type that wants to see a lot of effort, so talk in class! I recommend going to his office hours for paper just to discuss ideas. Also, go in with the right mentality and attitude, meaning don't expect an A automatically. Your writing skills will develop over time.

I will never wake up at 8:00am on tuesdays and thursdays again unless its for this class. Professor Dagger is ridiculously brilliant and he's one of those teachers that can actually TEACH rather than just show off how smart they are. If you are even slightly passionate about ethics and criminal justice take this class.

Dr. Dagger is a great professor! His classes are challenging, but he is incredibly clear about his expectations and what we need to know. He's really funny, too! One of my favorite classes at UR. Take his classes if you can!

I really enjoy Dr. Dagger's class! He teaching style is very clear and students know what is expected of them. He grades fairly and class participation is a must. It's one of my favorite classes this semester...I'm glad I've had the opportunity to take a class from him!

Super interesting guy, and a good guitar player! Lots of work so don't take him if you want an easy class. However, information from his class can be applied in alot of other political science classes.

The man, for real. I'm a moderate on most issues and he seemed to be fine with everything I wrote as long as I had sufficent evidence. He's about as libral as any other LIBERAL arts professor.Do the readings when you can and spend time on the essays and you'll get a good grade.
